title: Slow Cooker Lemon Pepper Chicken
description: For this slow cooker lemon pepper chicken recipe, a whole chicken, seasoned with lemon pepper, fresh garlic, and dried thyme is slow-cooked to perfection.
ingredients: 1 (2 to 3 pound) whole chicken, giblets removed
2 cloves garlic, lightly crushed, or more to taste
1 pinch cracked black pepper to taste

steps.text: Rinse chicken, pat dry with paper towels, and loosen skin over breast and thighs using your fingers.
Combine butter and lemon pepper in a small bowl; place under loosened skin using a teaspoon. Push butter from spoon using chicken skin; place garlic cloves and lemon slice in chicken cavity.
Place chicken into a slow cooker. Rub skin with olive oil; sprinkle with seasoned salt, thyme, and black pepper.

Cover slow cooker. Cook on High for 3 hours; reduce heat to Low and cook until chicken is very tender and an instant-read meat thermometer inserted into the thickest part of a thigh, near but not touching bone, reads at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C), 2 to 3 hours more. Or, cook chicken on Low for 6 to 8 hours (without cooking on High).
